decisions.rationale: The immutable pinned server returns accepted_response as a continue_setup wrapper but accepts only its inner response object on the next call. Retaining the wrapper makes a valid setup continuation undispatchable. Exact wrapper validation plus inner extraction is a localized compatibility correction with negligible regression surface.
decisions.smallest_fix: Require the exact accepted_response wrapper with tool continue_setup and a mapping response, then retain only the inner response for the authorized continuation call.

decisions.rationale: The changed positive limitation test still constructs the obsolete two-stage chain and inline artifacts, so it is red before reaching create-once behavior and proves none of the current closed limitation API. Updating only the test fixture to the implemented seven-stage, hash-referenced contract restores required regression value without weakening production validation.
decisions.smallest_fix: In the test-author lane, replace the legacy fixture with a minimal complete seven-stage immutable chain plus hash-bound terminal, process, protected-suite, assignment, execution, and successful substitute-result artifacts; retain create-once and rejection assertions.
